title: Pregnant Patients: Body Changes, Hypertension and Bleeding
next: Chapter 42, Lesson 2: Labour, normal and abnormal deliveries, and postpartum hemorrhage

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already treat two patients at once, turn a pregnant patient onto her left side, give oxygen and move fast. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Explain how pregnancy changes vital signs, shock and breathing
  2. Recognize preeclampsia and eclampsia, and know which book drugs aren't on the BC exam
  3. Sort out bleeding in pregnancy and what the PCP adds

Textbook: Chapter 42, PDF pages 3528–3574
slides.say: Welcome back. As EMRs, you know that a pregnant patient means at least two patients, that late in pregnancy she rides on her left side, and that oxygen and fast transport help. Now, as a PCP, you need to understand why her body behaves differently, so you can read her vital signs correctly. Your new drugs and IV fluids also come with new rules in pregnancy. Today we'll cover three things: how pregnancy changes the body, the high blood pressure disorders of pregnancy, and bleeding in pregnancy, including exactly what the PCP adds.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。作为 EMR，你们知道：孕妇至少意味着两个病人；孕晚期要让她左侧卧转运；给氧和快速转运很有帮助。现在作为 PCP，你要明白她的身体为什么反应不同，才能正确解读生命体征。你的新药和静脉补液，在孕期也有新的规矩。今天讲三件事：怀孕怎样改变身体；孕期高血压疾病；孕期出血，包括 PCP 具体多做什么。

slides.title: Pregnancy changes the numbers
slides.body:
SystemChange by termWhy it matters
Blood volumeup 40–50%hides blood loss
Heart rateup 15–20 beats/mintachycardia is harder to read
Breathingdiaphragm up about 4 cmless reserve, needs more O₂
Stomachempties slowlyhigh aspiration risk

She can lose up to 40% of her blood volume before the BP falls.
slides.say: Pregnancy changes what normal looks like. By term, blood volume rises by forty to fifty percent, and the resting heart rate is fifteen to twenty beats faster. The diaphragm is pushed up about four centimetres, so she has less lung reserve while needing more oxygen. Her stomach empties slowly, so aspiration is a real risk. Here's the key point for a PCP: with all that extra blood, she can lose up to forty percent of her blood volume before her blood pressure drops. So a normal blood pressure does not mean she's fine. Suspect shock from the mechanism and the story, not from the cuff.
slides.sayZh: 怀孕改变了「正常」的样子。到足月，血容量增加百分之四十到五十，静息心率快十五到二十次。膈肌被顶高约四厘米，肺的储备变少，而需氧却更多。胃排空慢，误吸风险很实在。对 PCP 来说关键是：因为多出的这些血，她可以丢掉多达百分之四十的血容量，血压才下降。所以血压正常不等于她没事。要从受伤机制和病史去怀疑休克，而不是看血压计。

slides.title: Supine hypotension: free the vena cava
slides.body:
After 20 weeks, lying flat→uterus presses the vena cava→less blood back, BP falls
  • After 3–7 min: nausea, dizziness, fast pulse, then fainting
  • Fix: left lateral position
  • On a spine board: wedge it about 30° to the left
  • Must stay flat: raise the right hip about 15 cm
  • Can happen sitting too; worse with low blood volume
slides.say: After about twenty weeks, when she lies flat on her back, the heavy uterus presses on the inferior vena cava, the big vein that carries blood back to the heart. Less blood returns, so cardiac output and blood pressure fall. After three to seven minutes she may feel sick, dizzy and short of breath, with a fast pulse, and she may faint. The fix is simple: turn her onto her left side. On a spine board, wedge pillows under it to tilt it about thirty degrees left. If she must stay flat, lift her right hip about fifteen centimetres. Low blood volume makes all of this worse.
slides.sayZh: 大约二十周以后，她平躺时，沉重的子宫压住下腔静脉，也就是把血送回心脏的大静脉。回心血少了，心输出量和血压都下降。三到七分钟后，她可能恶心、头晕、气短、心跳加快，甚至晕倒。处理很简单：让她左侧卧。在脊柱板上，就在板下垫枕头，让板向左倾斜约三十度。如果必须平躺，把右髋垫高约十五厘米。血容量低会让这一切更严重。

slides.title: Assessing her as a PCP
slides.body:
• G and P: G = all pregnancies; P = births after 20 weeks
  • Weeks pregnant, due date, prenatal care, past problems
  • Previous C-section? Higher risk of uterine rupture
  • Bleeding: how many pads? Clots or tissue?
  • Fetal heart rate: normal 120–160; below 120 = distress
  • Feel her pulse at the same time, so you don't count her heart
slides.say: Your history now goes deeper. Record gravida and para: gravida counts every pregnancy, whatever the outcome; para counts births after twenty weeks. So three pregnancies, one miscarriage at ten weeks and two babies is G3 P2. Many women forget to count miscarriages, so ask clearly. Ask her weeks, due date, prenatal care, and any problems now or before. A previous C-section raises the risk of uterine rupture. For bleeding, ask how many pads she has soaked and whether she passed clots or tissue. Then listen for the fetal heart: normal is one hundred twenty to one hundred sixty. Feel her pulse at the same time, so you don't count her heart by mistake.
slides.sayZh: 你的问诊现在要更深入。记录孕次和产次：孕次算所有怀孕，不管结局；产次算二十周以后的分娩。所以怀孕三次、十周时流产一次、生了两个孩子，就是 G3P2。很多人会忘了算流产，要问清楚。问孕周、预产期、产检，以及现在或以往有没有问题。以前做过剖宫产，子宫破裂风险更高。有出血时，问湿透了几片卫生巾，有没有排出血块或组织。然后听胎心，正常是一百二十到一百六十。同时摸她的脉搏，免得把她的心跳误数成胎心。

slides.title: High blood pressure in pregnancy
slides.body:
Chronic≥ 140/90 before pregnancy or before 20 weekswas already there
Gestationalnew high BP from 20 weeks ongoes away after birth
Preeclampsiagestational HTN + protein in urine, warning signs, or organ damagecan turn into eclampsia

Warning signs: severe headache, vision changes, abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting; swollen face and hands.
slides.say: Now the high blood pressure disorders. Chronic hypertension is one hundred forty over ninety or more, present before pregnancy or before twenty weeks. Gestational hypertension is new high pressure from twenty weeks on, and it goes away after the birth. Preeclampsia is the dangerous one: gestational hypertension plus protein in the urine, or warning signs, or organ damage. You can't test urine on scene, so watch for the warning signs: a severe headache, spots or blurred vision, abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting, and a puffy face and hands. Risk is higher in very young first-time mothers, women thirty-five or older, and those with chronic hypertension, kidney disease or diabetes.
slides.sayZh: 再来看高血压疾病。慢性高血压是血压一百四十比九十或更高，怀孕前或二十周前就存在。妊娠期高血压是二十周以后新出现的高血压，分娩后消失。子痫前期最危险：妊娠期高血压，加上尿蛋白，或者危险信号，或者器官损害。现场没法验尿，所以要盯住危险信号：剧烈头痛、眼前冒金星或视物模糊、腹痛、恶心呕吐，以及面部和手浮肿。很年轻的初孕妇、三十五岁及以上的女性，以及有慢性高血压、肾病或糖尿病的人，风险更高。

slides.q: A woman 34 weeks pregnant has a pounding headache and sees flashing spots. BP 168/108; her face and hands are puffy. Her BP was normal at 16 weeks. What is most likely?
slides.say: Time for a question. A woman thirty-four weeks pregnant has a pounding headache and sees flashing spots. Her blood pressure is one sixty-eight over one hundred eight, and her face and hands are puffy. Her blood pressure was normal at sixteen weeks. What is most likely? A, gestational hypertension only. B, preeclampsia. C, chronic hypertension. D, supine hypotensive syndrome. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做一道题。一位孕三十四周的女性头痛欲裂，眼前有闪光点，血压一百六十八比一百零八，脸和手浮肿；她十六周时血压正常。最可能是什么？A 单纯妊娠期高血压；B 子痫前期；C 慢性高血压；D 仰卧位低血压综合征。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B, preeclampsia. Her pressure was normal early on and is high after twenty weeks, and she has warning signs: a severe headache, vision changes and swelling. A is wrong because gestational hypertension alone has no warning signs. C is wrong because her pressure was normal at sixteen weeks, so it wasn't there before twenty weeks. D causes low blood pressure, not high.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B，子痫前期。她早期血压正常，二十周后升高，还有危险信号：剧烈头痛、视觉改变和浮肿。A 错，单纯妊娠期高血压没有这些危险信号；C 错，她十六周时血压正常，说明二十周前并没有高血压；D 引起的是低血压，不是高血压。

slides.title: Eclampsia: what a BC PCP can do
slides.body:
Preeclampsia + a seizure = eclampsia

  • Can happen before, during or after delivery
  • Airway, high-flow O₂ for two patients, left side, protect from injury
  • Check BGL: below 4.0 → treat hypoglycemia (PCP: D10W)
  • Rapid transport; warn the hospital
  • Not on the BC licensing exam: magnesium, labetalol, hydralazine, benzos
slides.say: If a patient with preeclampsia has a seizure, she now has eclampsia. It can happen before, during, or even after the birth. A seizure makes both patients hypoxic, so manage the airway, give high-flow oxygen, put her on her left side and protect her from injury. Check her blood sugar, because low sugar can also cause a seizure; below four point zero, treat it as hypoglycemia, and as a PCP that means D10W. Then transport fast and warn the hospital. Here's the PCP trap: the book's magnesium sulfate, labetalol, hydralazine, calcium and benzodiazepines aren't on the BC licensing exam. On the exam, your tools are airway, oxygen, position, glucose and transport.
slides.sayZh: 子痫前期的病人一旦抽搐，就成了子痫。它可以发生在分娩前、分娩中，甚至分娩后。抽搐会让两个病人都缺氧，所以要管好气道、给高流量氧、让她左侧卧，并防止受伤。测血糖，因为低血糖也会引起抽搐；低于四点零就按低血糖处理，作为 PCP 就是给 D10W。然后快速转运，预先通知医院。PCP 的陷阱是：书里的硫酸镁、拉贝洛尔、肼屈嗪、钙剂和苯二氮卓类，都不在 BC 执照考试范围内。考试中你的工具是气道、氧气、体位、血糖和转运。

slides.title: Vomiting in pregnancy: drug cautions
slides.body:
Hyperemesis gravidarum: vomiting many times a day, leading to dehydration

BC drugPregnancy point (BC monograph)
Dimenhydrinate (PCP)1 mg/kg, max 50 mg; pregnancy is a caution
Ondansetron (PCP)4 mg PO; relative contraindication in 1st trimester
Ibuprofencontraindicated in any trimester
Methoxyfluranecontraindicated: pregnant, planning, breastfeeding
slides.say: Hyperemesis gravidarum is not ordinary morning sickness: it's vomiting more than three or four times a day, leading to dehydration and poor nutrition. As a PCP you now carry antiemetics, drugs against nausea, but pregnancy changes the rules. Dimenhydrinate, or Gravol, is one milligram per kilogram up to fifty milligrams, and the BC monograph lists pregnancy as a caution. Ondansetron is four milligrams by mouth, and the first trimester is a relative contraindication. Ibuprofen is contraindicated in any trimester, and methoxyflurane is contraindicated in pregnancy, when planning one, and while breastfeeding. So before any drug, ask: is she pregnant, or could she be?
slides.sayZh: 妊娠剧吐不是普通孕吐：一天呕吐超过三四次，导致脱水和营养不良。作为 PCP，你现在带着止吐药，但怀孕会改变规矩。茶苯海明（Gravol）是每公斤一毫克，最多五十毫克，BC 药物专论把怀孕列为注意事项。昂丹司琼口服四毫克，孕早期是相对禁忌。布洛芬孕期任何阶段都禁用；甲氧氟烷在怀孕、备孕和哺乳期都禁用。所以给任何药之前都要问：她怀孕了吗，或者有可能怀孕吗？

slides.title: Bleeding early in pregnancy
slides.body:
• Ectopic pregnancy: implanted outside the uterus, usually a tube
  • Severe lower abdominal pain, may be in shock
  • Childbearing age + severe lower abdominal pain → think ectopic
  • Miscarriage: pregnancy lost before 20 weeks; about 1 in 5
  • Bring any tissue she has passed; give emotional support
  • Any pregnant patient with bleeding or abdominal pain → hospital
slides.say: Bleeding in the first half of pregnancy has two big causes. Ectopic pregnancy means the fertilized egg implanted outside the uterus, usually in a fallopian tube. It can't grow to term, and if it ruptures it can bleed heavily inside the abdomen. So any woman of childbearing age with severe lower abdominal pain has an ectopic pregnancy until proven otherwise: treat for shock and transport fast. The other cause is miscarriage, losing a pregnancy before twenty weeks, which happens in about one in five pregnancies. Bring any tissue she passed, and be kind; an early loss is still a loss. Every pregnant patient with bleeding or abdominal pain goes to hospital.
slides.sayZh: 孕前半期出血有两大原因。异位妊娠是受精卵着床在子宫外，通常在输卵管。它不可能长到足月，一旦破裂，腹腔内会大量出血。所以任何育龄女性下腹剧痛，在排除前都按异位妊娠处理：抗休克、快速转运。另一个原因是流产，即二十周前妊娠丢失，大约每五次怀孕就有一次。把她排出的组织带去医院，并且要体贴，早期流产也是真实的失去。凡是有出血或腹痛的孕妇，都要送医院。

slides.title: Late bleeding: abruption or previa?
slides.body:
Abruptio placentaePlacenta previa
Whatplacenta tears off earlyplacenta covers the cervix
Painsudden, severe, into the backpainless
Uterusrigid, tendersoft
Bloodmay be hidden; shock > visible lossbright red
Fetusless movement, heart tones dropusually normal at first

Third-trimester bleeding = emergency. No vaginal exam, no packing, no deep palpation.
slides.say: In the third trimester, any vaginal bleeding is an emergency until proven otherwise. In abruptio placentae, the placenta tears away from the uterine wall too early. The pain is sudden and severe, often into the back, the uterus is hard and tender, and blood can stay hidden, so the shock is worse than the bleeding you see. The baby moves less and its heart tones drop. High blood pressure is the most common cause, then trauma. In placenta previa, the placenta sits low over the cervix. The bleeding is bright red and painless, the uterus is soft, and the baby is usually fine at first. Never press deeply, and never examine inside the vagina.
slides.sayZh: 孕晚期任何阴道出血，在排除之前都是急症。胎盘早剥是胎盘过早从子宫壁剥离：疼痛突然剧烈，常放射到背部，子宫硬、有压痛，血可能藏在里面，所以休克比看到的出血更重；胎动减少，胎心变弱。最常见原因是高血压，其次是创伤。前置胎盘是胎盘长得低、盖住宫颈：出血鲜红、不痛，子宫软，胎儿起初通常正常。绝不要深压腹部，也绝不要做阴道内检查。

slides.q: You're the PCP. A woman 35 weeks pregnant has painless, bright red bleeding. HR 124, BP 86/56, pale and clammy. Transport time is 20 minutes. What is the best plan?
options: Do a gentle vaginal exam to find the source, then transport
Left side, O₂, warmth, go; IV en route, 20 mL/kg up to 2 L, reassess per 500 mL
Lay her flat on her back and start the IV on scene before moving
Pack the vagina with gauze to stop the bleeding, then transport
slides.say: Now a PCP decision. A woman thirty-five weeks pregnant has painless, bright red bleeding. Heart rate one twenty-four, blood pressure eighty-six over fifty-six, pale and clammy. Transport is twenty minutes. What's the best plan? A, a gentle vaginal exam to find the source, then transport. B, left side, high-flow oxygen, keep her warm and go, with the IV en route: twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. C, flat on her back, and start the IV on scene before moving. D, pack the vagina with gauze, then transport. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位孕三十五周的女性无痛性鲜红色出血，心率一百二十四，血压八十六比五十六，苍白湿冷，转运二十分钟。最好的方案是什么？A 轻轻做阴道检查找出血点，再转运；B 左侧卧、高流量氧、保暖、出发，途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评；C 让她平躺，先在现场开好静脉再搬；D 用纱布填塞阴道，再转运。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. She's in shock, so the BC hypovolemia protocol applies: the PCP starts the IV en route, twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred, while the left side keeps the uterus off the vena cava. A is wrong because an internal exam can make a previa bleed heavily. C is wrong twice: flat at thirty-five weeks squeezes the vena cava, and the IV shouldn't delay transport. D is wrong: never pack; place a pad over the opening.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。她已休克，适用 BC 低血容量流程：PCP 途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评；左侧卧让子宫离开下腔静脉。A 错，内检可能让前置胎盘大出血。C 错两处：三十五周平躺会压迫下腔静脉，开静脉也不应耽误转运。D 错：绝不能填塞，只在阴道口外放垫子。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: bleeding in pregnancy
slides.body:
BC Hypovolemia protocol: hypovolemia + systolic < 90 + other signs of shock; may start earlier if shock is expected

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Control external bleeding (book: pad, never pack)
  • Supine to support BP (book: tilt left after 20 weeks)
  • Keep warm
  • O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%; shock = high flow

PCP adds (en route or if delayed)

  • Vascular access (IV)
  • Bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL
  • TXA: next lesson, with its BC limits
slides.say: Bleeding in pregnancy with shock fits the BC hypovolemia protocol: low volume, a systolic under ninety, and other signs of shock, and you may start earlier if you expect shock. Every licence level controls external bleeding, which here means a pad, never packing; positions to support the blood pressure; keeps her warm; and gives oxygen, high flow in shock. The protocol says supine; the book reminds us that after twenty weeks, flat squeezes the vena cava, so tilt her left. The right column is yours as a PCP: en route, start an IV, give twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, and reassess every five hundred.
slides.sayZh: 有休克的孕期出血符合 BC 低血容量流程：血容量低、收缩压低于九十、并有其他休克征象；预计会休克时可以更早启动。所有执照级别都要控制外出血，这里指放垫子、绝不填塞；摆体位支持血压；保暖；给氧，休克时用高流量。流程写的是仰卧；书里提醒，二十周以后平躺会压迫下腔静脉，所以要让她向左倾斜。右栏是你作为 PCP 做的：途中开静脉，每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Normal BP ≠ stable: she can lose 40% first
  • Her resting HR runs 15–20 higher: trend it, don't explain it away
  • IV and fluids en route; never delay transport for a line
  • Before every drug: is she pregnant, or could she be?
  • Fetal heart below 120 = distress: report it, move fast
  • Seizure risk lasts after the birth too
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch out for. A normal blood pressure doesn't mean she's stable; she can lose forty percent of her blood first. Her resting heart rate is already higher, so follow the trend, and don't explain away a rising pulse as just the pregnancy. Your IV belongs en route; never hold her on scene for a line. Before every drug, ask whether she's pregnant or could be. A fetal heart rate below one hundred twenty means fetal distress, so tell the hospital and move. And preeclampsia doesn't end the moment the baby is born; a seizure can still come later.
slides.sayZh: 新的注意事项如下。血压正常不等于病情稳定，她可能已经丢了百分之四十的血。她的静息心率本来就偏高，所以要看趋势，别把越来越快的脉搏当成「只是怀孕」。开静脉放在途中，绝不为了开静脉把她留在现场。每次给药前都问她是否怀孕或可能怀孕。胎心低于一百二十意味着胎儿窘迫，要通知医院、加快行动。还有，子痫前期不会在孩子出生那一刻就结束，之后仍可能抽搐。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Magnesium sulfate, labetalol, hydralazine, calcium: not on the BC licensing exam
  • No benzodiazepines on the exam either
  • Book fluids: 250 mL steps → BC: 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess every 500 mL
  • Hypoglycemia: BGL < 4.0 mmol/L; IV dextrose = D10W only
  • EMRs have no IV access; fluids are a PCP skill
  • Ibuprofen and methoxyflurane: contraindicated in pregnancy
slides.say: Now the book versus BC. The book uses magnesium sulfate for eclampsia, labetalol or hydralazine for severe hypertension, and calcium as magnesium's antidote. None of these are on the BC licensing exam, and neither are benzodiazepines. For third-trimester bleeding the book gives two hundred fifty millilitre steps; for the BC exam, use the hypovolemia protocol: twenty millilitres per kilogram, maximum two litres, reassessing every five hundred. BC treats a glucose below four point zero as hypoglycemia, and the only IV dextrose is D10W. EMRs have no IV access, so fluids are a PCP skill. And ibuprofen and methoxyflurane are contraindicated in pregnancy.
slides.sayZh: 现在对比原书和 BC。原书用硫酸镁治子痫，用拉贝洛尔或肼屈嗪治严重高血压，用钙剂解硫酸镁的毒；这些都不在 BC 执照考试范围内，苯二氮卓类也不在。孕晚期出血时原书每次补两百五十毫升；考 BC 用低血容量流程：每公斤二十毫升、最多两升、每五百毫升复评。BC 把血糖低于四点零按低血糖处理，静脉葡萄糖只有 D10W。EMR 没有静脉通路权限，补液是 PCP 的技能。还有，布洛芬和甲氧氟烷孕期禁用。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Pregnancy hides shock: she can lose 40% before the BP falls; keep her tilted left
  2. Preeclampsia: high BP after 20 weeks + warning signs; no BC exam drug for it
  3. Bleeding with shock: PCP adds IV en route, 20 mL/kg (max 2 L), reassess every 500 mL

Next: labour, normal and abnormal deliveries, and postpartum hemorrhage
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: pregnancy hides shock. She can lose forty percent of her blood before the pressure falls, and after twenty weeks she belongs on her left side or tilted left. Two: preeclampsia comes after twenty weeks, with high blood pressure plus warning signs like a severe headache, vision changes and swelling. The BC exam gives you no drug for it, so your job is airway, oxygen, glucose, fast transport, and being ready for a seizure. Three: bleeding with shock means the hypovolemia protocol, and the PCP adds an IV en route, twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. Next lesson: labour, deliveries, and bleeding after birth. If anything was unclear, tap Ask.
